map.评估上面级能否把载荷送入目标轨道。: Assess whether an upper stage can place the payload into the target orbit.

map.为什么单级火箭很难入轨？: Why is a single-stage rocket so hard to put into orbit?
map.入轨需 Δv≈9.4 km/s（含重力/阻力损失更多）。由公式，Δv 随质量比对: Orbit insertion needs Δv≈9.4 km/s (more with gravity/drag losses). By the formula, Δv grows logarithmically with the mass ratio, so raising 4.7 to 9.4 would require the mass ratio to go from 5 to 25, which the structure can hardly bear, hence the use of multiple stages that drop shells one by one.

map.齐奥尔科夫斯基火箭方程 Δv = 比冲 Isp × 9.81 × ln(初始质量: Tsiolkovsky rocket equation Δv = specific impulse Isp × 9.81 × ln(initial mass m₀ ÷ final mass m_f) (g₀ fixed at 9.81 m/s²), shown in both m/s and km/s. Validation: Isp, m₀, and m_f are guarded as non-empty numbers. Criteria: the larger the mass ratio m₀ ÷ m_f, the larger Δv (logarithmic growth with diminishing returns); the propellant fraction sets the upper limit of achievable velocity increment.
